About Pearl Lemon Leads
Building connections that deliver measurable growth
BOOK A CALL!
Who We Are
Specialists in UK-based B2B lead generation
Pearl Lemon Leads is a London-born lead generation agency dedicated to helping businesses secure consistent, qualified opportunities. Founded in 2016 by Deepak Shukla, we have grown from a small UK consultancy into an international team of more than 130 professionals. Our focus is on helping companies across the UK and beyond secure new business through structured outreach campaigns, targeted appointment setting, LinkedIn prospecting, and cold email outreach.
Our work is trusted by startups, SMEs, and established enterprises alike, giving businesses the reliable pipelines they need to strengthen sales activity and reach more clients.
BOOK A CALL!
Our Mission
Supporting businesses with consistent lead generation strategies
Our mission is to make lead generation straightforward, measurable, and effective for UK businesses. We work to deliver qualified leads that give sales teams the opportunity to focus on what they do best—closing deals and building long-term client relationships.
Whether it’s a local business in Manchester, a property firm in London, or a technology company in Birmingham, we are committed to providing measurable outcomes that directly support commercial growth.
Our Vision
Setting new standards for lead generation in the UK market
We aim to become the most trusted name in lead generation for UK businesses. By continually refining our systems and processes, we want to ensure that organisations across industries can rely on Pearl Lemon Leads to deliver consistent pipelines and measurable growth. Our long-term vision is to build a reputation as the partner businesses think of first when they need leads that actually convert into opportunities.
Our Story
From London roots to global reach
Pearl Lemon Leads was founded by Deepak Shukla, a former Deloitte consultant and lifelong entrepreneur. In 2016, after years of experience in digital marketing, sales, and building online visibility, Deepak set out to create a results-focused marketing agency. What began in London soon became Pearl Lemon—a group of businesses spanning SEO, PR, legal services, property, and accounting.
Lead generation quickly became one of the most indemand services, and Pearl Lemon Leads was born as a dedicated branch focused solely on helping clients secure new business opportunities. From our UK foundations, we’ve expanded into a global operation with team members working across Europe, Africa, Asia, and North America—while still keeping our London origins at the heart of what we do.

What Sets Us Apart
Clear processes, measurable outcomes, and flexibility for every client
Pearl Lemon Leads is not just another agency promising vague results. Our difference lies in:
Accountability:
Transparent reporting and communication, so clients see exactly where opportunities are coming from.
Flexibility:
We work with multiple models—retainerbased, or projectdriven—allowing businesses to choose what works best for them.
Industry range:
From finance and property to healthcare, technology, and professional services, our team has direct experience across a wide set of sectors.
Proven expertise:
With over 1,000 five star reviews and campaigns executed worldwide, our methods are built on years of delivering measurable outcomes for businesses of every size.

Meet Our Leadership
Experienced professionals guiding global teams
Deepak Shukla – Founder & CEO
Deepak is the founder of Pearl Lemon and the driving force behind Pearl Lemon Leads. A former Deloitte consultant and accomplished entrepreneur, he brings over 15 years of expertise in sales, marketing, and business growth. His career has included delivering three TEDx talks, appearing on more than 10,000 podcasts and interviews, and building Pearl Lemon Group into a multi-vertical agency serving clients across the UK and worldwide. Away from business, Deepak is also an Ironman triathlete, marathon runner, and published author, bringing the same level of discipline and commitment to the company as he does to his personal pursuits.
Key Achievements
Steady growth built on performance and reliability
2016 – Founded in London
Pearl Lemon was established in London by Deepak Shukla. What began as a small consultancy quickly developed into a full-service agency, with its first clients in SEO and marketing. This early stage set the foundations for what would become a multi-vertical group.
2017–2018 – Expansion into SEO, PR, and Lead Generation
Building on its early success, Pearl Lemon broadened its services. SEO became a core offering, supported by digital PR campaigns and structured lead generation services. By this stage, Pearl Lemon had established its presence in both UK and international markets, delivering results for businesses across a range of sectors.
2020 – Remote-First Structure Established
With the shift towards global remote work, Pearl Lemon transitioned into a remote-first organisation. The team grew to more than 75 staff distributed across multiple countries. This structure allowed the business to provide around-the-clock support for UK clients as well as international partners.
2023 – Pay-Per-Lead Division Launched
Recognising the demand for performance-based models, Pearl Lemon Leads introduced a dedicated pay-per-lead division. This service quickly gained traction with UK and US businesses, particularly in finance, property, healthcare, and technology. The model provided clients with predictable costs and measurable outcomes, reinforcing Pearl Lemon’s reputation as a reliable partner.
2025 – Global Team of 130+ Professionals
Today, Pearl Lemon Leads operates with more than 130 professionals worldwide. With its headquarters in London and a global network spanning Europe, Africa, Asia, and North America, the company serves clients across industries including digital marketing, property, finance, healthcare, education, and eCommerce.

Frequently Asked Questions
Clear answers to common client queries
How do you ensure the leads you provide are qualified?
We use a combination of research, targeting, and pre-qualification processes to ensure that the leads we deliver match your target audience. Each campaign is designed around agreed criteria, so the prospects we present are relevant and valuable to your business.
Do you work with businesses outside the UK?
Yes. While we are based in London, we support clients across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and beyond. Many UK businesses also use our services to target international markets.
Can I outsource all of my lead generation to Pearl Lemon Leads?
Absolutely. Many of our clients rely on us as their complete outsourced lead generation partner. We manage everything from LinkedIn outreach and cold emails to appointment setting, freeing your sales team to focus on closing deals.
What industries do you specialise in?
We work across multiple industries, including technology, finance, healthcare, property, education, and eCommerce. Our flexible approach allows us to adapt to the unique needs of each sector.
How soon can I expect results?
Lead generation timelines can vary depending on your industry, target audience, and chosen channels. Typically, clients start to see qualified leads coming through within the first 4–8 weeks of a campaign.
